versionRedaction: GitHub's public advisory HTML and REST API render the 16.3 patched patch-digit as '?'. The strings below are the literal vendor fields. v16.3.8 release notes list every 30 Sep advisory, and git compare v16.3.7...v16.3.8 contains the corresponding security commits. v16.3.7, published 2026-09-29, is a bugfix backport and does not list them.

advisories.summary: Server-Side Request Forgery in Image Optimization
advisories.runtimePrerequisite: images.remotePatterns or another allow-listed remote image URL
advisories.evidence: next.config.js remotePatterns; no runtime next/image URL uses the three hosts
advisories.after16_3_8: Vendor DNS-pinning fix is in the installed release. Allowlist unchanged.
advisories.residual: Azure pathname /** stays broader than any in-repo call site. Hostnames stay fixed, not attacker-chosen.

advisories.summary: Information disclosure in App Router metadata image routes via dynamicParams bypass
advisories.runtimePrerequisite: webpack metadata image routes such as opengraph-image or twitter-image that ignore dynamicParams
advisories.evidence: 0 opengraph-image/twitter-image route files, 0 dynamicParams, 0 generateStaticParams. Open Graph uses static /images/hero-bali.png.
advisories.after16_3_8: Patched release installed. Prerequisite still absent.

advisories.summary: Cache poisoning of SSG and ISR pages in self-hosted Next.js applications
advisories.runtimePrerequisite: self-hosted Pages Router SSG or ISR. Vendor: applications deployed on Vercel are not affected.
advisories.evidence: vercel.json version 2, no pages/ directory, no output standalone
advisories.after16_3_8: Patched release installed. Prerequisite still absent.
advisories.residual: none while Production stays on Vercel

advisories.summary: Cache poisoning in SSG/ISR rendering with a root catch-all
advisories.runtimePrerequisite: root-level catch-all page together with SSG or ISR
advisories.evidence: 0 catch-all route directories. Only dynamic segment is app/(public)/reisen/[tripId], force-dynamic.
advisories.after16_3_8: Patched release installed. Prerequisite still absent.

advisories.summary: Pending use cache fill can leak Draft Mode content
advisories.versionAffectedOn16_3_3: range-string-is-exactly-16.3.0; 16.3.3 is not proven inside that literal string. The 16.3.8 release still lists this advisory.
advisories.runtimePrerequisite: Cache Components or experimental.useCache, plus Draft Mode previews whose cached functions return draft content
advisories.evidence: next.config.js has no cacheComponents and no useCache. 0 use cache directives. 0 draftMode() calls.
advisories.after16_3_8: Patched release installed. Prerequisite still absent.

advisories.summary: Cache leak across root param values in nested use cache functions
advisories.versionAffectedOn16_3_3: range-string-is-exactly-16.3.0; 16.3.3 is not proven inside that literal string. The 16.3.8 release still lists this advisory.
advisories.runtimePrerequisite: cacheComponents: true and nested use cache functions that read a root param
advisories.evidence: cacheComponents is absent. 0 use cache directives. No root params.
advisories.after16_3_8: Patched release installed. Prerequisite still absent.

advisories.summary: Information disclosure in the development server MCP endpoint
advisories.runtimePrerequisite: next dev only. Production deployments do not serve the endpoint.
advisories.evidence: No production route serves the dev MCP endpoint. App runtime is nodejs.
advisories.after16_3_8: Local and Preview dev servers that install this pin are on the patched release.
advisories.residual: Developers who keep an older next dev binary remain exposed. This slice does not change production config.

advisories.summary: Remote Code Execution in next/og ImageResponse
advisories.runtimePrerequisite: Node.js ImageResponse from next/og with attacker-controlled SVG content, attributes, or styles
advisories.evidence: 0 next/og imports and 0 ImageResponse identifiers in app, components, lib, and hooks, excluding tests.
advisories.residual: No reachable ImageResponse path before or after the upgrade.
